title: Launch on Florida's Space Coast
description:
Launch on Florida's Space Coast is an opportunity for job seekers, including those from the military community, to come together without one organization owning the agenda. We bring recruiters, business leaders, veterans & military spouses, organizations, and advocates to network in a low-pressure environment. FREE to attend, donations and sponsorships are appreciated to offset event costs.

Register to attend upcoming events here: \[[www.linkedinspacecoast.com](http://www.linkedinspacecoast.com)\]([https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.linkedinspacecoast.com/&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1766337290812098&usg=AOvVaw03ll1sjCl1Tg-fHG--4tS0](https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.linkedinspacecoast.com/&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1766337290812098&usg=AOvVaw03ll1sjCl1Tg-fHG--4tS0))
